task_name: Build existing-card picker, paste, gallery, lightbox, and delete UI

concerns_addressed: Cycle 3 did not produce a RED failure — Observation (valid), not a missing requirement. Parent BoardContext already scheduleRefresh()s on attachment.* (BoardContext.tsx:711-736). CardAttachments reads live card.attachments; ContextPanel derives that card from findCardInColumns(columns). The integration test documents EventSource → board refresh → 3/3 gallery without extra production wiring, matching task step 15 ('only the component/test wiring needed'). Red-flag check: the test doubles EventSource/HTTP only, not BoardProvider internals.

Cycle-1 Important (nested Escape also closed ContextPanel) re-checked against HEAD 5f02e13: capture-phase preventDefault + stopImmediatePropagation on window while lightbox/delete is open; unit tests assert the parent window listener does not run and the Images region stays mounted.

strengths: Extracted attachment UI into CardAttachments without copying CardEditor; ContextPanel only composes and passes card/workspace/callbacks.
Native multiple file input, clipboard image blobs, T3 prepareImageAttachment, and exact batch copy vs persistent total (2 of 4… vs 3/3 from card.attachments.length).
Gallery/lightbox/download/delete have explicit accessible names; last-empty props render no-media copy; download uses /original/download.
Existing OKLCH/Tailwind tokens and focus-visible rings; no drag-and-drop, cover reorder, annotation, tracker/card field mutation, public upload URLs, T12 staging, or T13 tile cover.
SSE gallery refresh is the T9 attachment.* → refresh path plus live column card props; integration test does not mock BoardProvider state.
Fix 5f02e13 isolates nested Escape in capture phase and moves initial focus into Close/Cancel with restore on dismiss, matching ContextPanel's window bubble close listener.

issues.description: Lightbox and delete confirmation still do not trap Tab. Initial focus now moves to Close/Cancel and is restored on dismiss, but Tab/Shift+Tab can leave the overlay and land on ContextPanel controls underneath. In-repo dialogs (TrackerConfirmDialog, FocusSwitchDialog) wrap Tab on the first/last focusable.
